Airy the Stubborn

Biography

Airy the Stubborn is Estera’s strong-willed granddaughter. Determined to be taken seriously by Zak and her grandmother, she investigates the way into the Dead City and explains how a lizard’s amulet can lead a dragon against the harpies at the observatory. Her attempt to find the magician places her in danger, and Zak’s search for her becomes part of his dealings with Shei-Var. [1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6]
